problem_text:
A logistics firm must dispatch a specialized technician to calibrate equipment at eight distinct facilities.

The travel durations between facilities are recorded in minutes:
* Facility Alpha to Beta: 119.4 minutes
* Alpha to Gamma: 12.5 minutes
* Alpha to Delta: 175.0 minutes
* Alpha to Epsilon: 43.9 minutes
* Alpha to Zeta: 103.2 minutes
* Alpha to Eta: 159.5 minutes
* Alpha to Theta: 125.2 minutes
* Beta to Gamma: 110.1 minutes
* Beta to Delta: 125.0 minutes
* Beta to Epsilon: 153.9 minutes
* Beta to Zeta: 36.1 minutes
* Beta to Eta: 98.4 minutes
* Beta to Theta: 39.6 minutes
* Gamma to Delta: 174.5 minutes
* Gamma to Epsilon: 56.4 minutes
* Gamma to Zeta: 91.8 minutes
* Gamma to Eta: 157.3 minutes
* Gamma to Theta: 119.1 minutes
* Delta to Epsilon: 180.7 minutes
* Delta to Zeta: 156.4 minutes
* Delta to Eta: 26.9 minutes
* Delta to Theta: 85.5 minutes
* Epsilon to Zeta: 143.6 minutes
* Epsilon to Eta: 171.1 minutes
* Epsilon to Theta: 150.5 minutes
* Zeta to Eta: 130.6 minutes
* Zeta to Theta: 72.0 minutes
* Eta to Theta: 59.1 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient inspection circuit, whereby the technician initiates the tour from a designated facility, visits every other facility precisely once, and ultimately concludes the assignment at the original point of departure.
